title: Revise ADR-0094: the permission write-through path 403s under the ADR-0005 rollback — move it to the materialized layer or retire the 2026-07-14 direction confirmation (#6609 ruling A follow-through)
body:
Part of #6609 (maintainer ruling 2026-08-09, verbatim: 「同意 A」— recorded in #6609 comment 5229170354). Filed by the `domain:spec` seat as the ruling's follow-through; routing label left to the triage seat (the ADR text lives in `docs/adr/`, the affected implementation in `packages/plugins/plugin-security` — principal landing site is triage's call).

## What the ruling requires

ADR-0094 carries a 2026-07-14 direction confirmation — «package 集经 ADR-0005 overlay 做环境定制» — written into the `plugin-security/src/permission-set-projection.ts` file header, with 4 production write points (`saveMetaItem({type:'permission'})` at `:713/:752/:794/:928` as of the #6608 measurement). Under the ruled ADR-0005 rollback (PR #6608, `permission.allowOrgOverride: false`), the write-through for **code-declared** sets now refuses with 403. Ruling A accepts the tightening and requires the ADR to stop pointing at a path that 403s:

- **either** re-route the environment-customization intent to the layer measured UNAFFECTED at the #6608 boundary probe (runtime-create / metadata-door **materialized** rows via the `allowRuntimeCreate` layer),
- **or** retire the direction confirmation outright.

Whichever way, the `permission-set-projection.ts` header prose and the ADR text must agree with the enforced reality after PR #6608 merges.

## Boundaries

- ⛔ No behavior change to the rollback itself — Option C was explicitly closed.
- The projection's 4 write points: whether they are re-pointed, guarded, or left to 403 loudly is part of this card's design work (the 403 is fail-closed and currently exercised by zero in-repo corpus rows — measured 0 live org-scoped overlay rows).
- Blocked-by: #6483 (lands via PR #6608 — the ADR revision describes the post-merge world; write it against that reality).

Refs: #6609 (ruling + full evidence chain), PR #6608 (implementation + boundary probe), ADR-0005, ADR-0094, #5768 (objectui consumer symptom).
